claim_set.claim_text: Every AI-flagged or AI-interpreted imaging finding MUST map to a named radiologist or reporting clinician with the prescribed authority before it enters the diagnostic record. Findings lacking named-clinician sign-off are refused at the action-admissibility gate.

Every material AI-assisted image-interpretation decision MUST emit a signed, replay-derivable Evidence Pack binding owner identity, the model and version that produced the finding, the clinical obligation discharged, and the Authority Finality outcome.

Every change to the model, algorithm, or version of a deployed imaging Software as a Medical Device MUST be authorised under a Predetermined Change Control Plan with named authority and supporting evidence before rollout.
Every AI-assisted access to imaging personal data (including DICOM studies and embedded identifiers) MUST be purpose-scoped and minimised to what the declared clinical purpose requires.
